hazards.description: Continuous lines of parked cars on both sides of the street block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly at potential mid-block crossing points.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible street length

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or signage may lead to unpredictable pedestrian movements and reduced driver awareness.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway visible in the foreground and mid-block

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is located in the center of the sidewalk, significantly narrowing the clear path for pedestrians and wheelchair users.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: Minor cracking and patching in the concrete sidewalk may present a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground sidewalk sections.

hazards.name: Uneven Walkway
hazards.description: Minor vertical displacements between concrete sidewalk slabs create potential trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk area in front of the red houses

hazards.name: Uneven and Cracked Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk pavement is severely degraded with large cracks and uneven slabs, posing a significant trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire foreground walkway.

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalks
hazards.description: The effective walking width is significantly reduced by building steps and the narrow overall design, making it difficult for pedestrians to pass one another.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street, particularly on the left where steps encroach.
